rules.sentence: For severe infections or in immunocompromised patients, anti-pseudomonal antibiotics such as fourth-generation or higher cephalosporins or extended-spectrum penicillins like piperacillin-tazobactam should be considered.
Carbapenems like meropenem should also be reserved for severe infections.
Surgical management of a dental abscess can include a root canal or tooth extraction.
If there is a periapical dental abscess, it may require incision and drainage.
